title: Objective-to-Investment Mapping and Initiative Spend Allocation Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Company-level OKRs currently drive initiatives without a consistent mapping to investment (headcount, run-rate, reserved capacity) which leads to ad-hoc re-prioritization mid-quarter and unclear trade-offs between cost, risk, and customer impact.

Goal: Create a repeatable playbook that ties each company objective to a prioritized list of initiatives with clear investment envelopes, decision gates, and an operational cadence for spend re-allocation during quarter execution. The playbook must be lightweight (suitable for weekly cadence) and integrate with existing roadmap artifacts and finance controls.

Scope: Corporate-level objectives and direct cross-functional initiatives only (Product, Engineering, Research, Sales Ops, Platform). Not covering team-level sprint resource planning or contractor procurement process changes.

Key outputs:
- Objective Investment Matrix template (OKR -> initiative -> funding band -> owner -> metrics)
- Decision gate checklist for mid-quarter re-allocation (triggers, approvers, rollback plan)
- Weekly signal dashboard for spend velocity vs. objective progress
- Runbook for escalation to exec OKR forum
acceptance_criteria: Objective Investment Matrix template is published in Confluence and filled for top 6 company objectives
Finance approves the funding band definitions and mapping to cost buckets (headcount/capacity/cloud)
Weekly spend-vs-progress dashboard ingests data from Console cost APIs and is accessible to execs
Two cross-functional dry-run tabletop exercises completed and post-mortems captured

2026-02-25 - Design review: proposed dashboard wireframes accepted with small changes to signal coloring for risk state.
2026-03-01 - Engineering indicated telemetry gaps for token-level cost attribution; opened dependency ENG-22501 (see dependencies).
2026-03-08 - Exec steering: approved pilot, requested stronger guardrails for run-rate adjustments (added gating checklist).
2026-03-10 - Launched first weekly dashboard ingest for pilot objectives; initial variance signals flagged two initiatives for review.
decisions: Treat Dedicated capacity as 'reserved' spend and exclude from short-term re-allocation unless exec-approved
Define three funding bands per objective: Seed (low), Scale (medium), Protect (high); map to headcount/compute buckets
Use weekly cadence for spend-review signals and monthly cadence for formal re-allocation windows
Require Finance and PM approval for any initiative movement that changes expected run-rate >10%
notes_for_engineering: ENG needs to expose token-level cost attribution by model/route (minimal fields: model, route, tokens_in, tokens_out)
Telemetry iteration should aim for <24h freshness for weekly signals to be meaningful
Fallback: if token-level is delayed, use bucketed cost estimates by service and map to initiatives via owner tags
playbook_actions: Publish Objective Investment Matrix template and run a 90-minute onboarding for initiative owners
Kick off two tabletop exercises with cross-functional leads to exercise gating and rollback scenarios
Instrument dashboard data feeds and validate with finance ledger for one pilot objective
Create an 'OKR spend' label in Linear for initiative tickets to enable automated cost roll-ups
retrospective_plan: After pilot quarter, run a 1.5 hour retro with execs, finance, and initiative owners to evaluate allocation accuracy
Capture signal-to-action latency and update gating thresholds based on measured velocity
Decide whether to expand to full company roll-out in subsequent planning cycle
